title: Transcript-bound directional session crypto
summary: After both 256-bit random nonces are known, the PSK and authenticated transcript derive a per-connection root, then independent client-to-server and server-to-client ChaCha20 keys, HMAC-SHA-512 keys and nonces.
invariants: The transport PSK must be at least 256 bits / 64 hexadecimal characters.
C2S and S2C encryption keys, MAC keys and nonces are separately labelled and therefore direction-separated.
The connection transcript participates in the root derivation; fresh nonces create fresh session material.
Do not reuse one directional key/nonce pair for traffic in the opposite direction.

provenance.claim: Documentation states derivation labels, direction separation, session binding and minimum PSK size.
Source derives independent C2S/S2C encryption, MAC and nonce material from protocol-labelled root HMAC.
Endpoint validates minimum PSK length and supplies HMAC/session derivation through the transport authority.
